verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting is available via three methods.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "here are the three ways to vote" (R1); "There are three ways to vote on American Idol: online, by app and by text" (R2); "three convenient ways to vote" (R3); "voting now occurs in one of three ways: on the show's website, via text message, and on social media" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state three voting methods.

verifications.claim: One American Idol 2026 voting method is online at AmericanIdol.com/Vote.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly name the exact URL as a voting method.

verifications.claim: One American Idol 2026 voting method is by texting the contestant's number to 21523.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "text the voting numbers of the contestant ... to “21523”" (R1); "text the number of the contestant you’re voting for to 21523" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm text voting to 21523.

verifications.claim: One American Idol 2026 voting method is via official Instagram and TikTok pinned posts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "@AmericanIdol on Facebook, Instagram or TikTok. In the official pinned social media post" (R1); "pinned official voting post ... on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok" (R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm social voting via pinned posts on Instagram and TikTok (among others).

verifications.claim: Up to 10 votes per contestant per method can be cast for American Idol 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "limit of 10 votes per contestant per method" (R1); "up to 10 votes for each contestant per voting method" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state the 10-vote limit per method per contestant.

verifications.claim: A total of 30+ votes can be cast per contestant for American Idol 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "total of 50 votes ... across all voting methods" (R1); "for a total of 30 votes" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources support totals of 30 or 50 (both >=30+); minor discrepancy in exact total but claim holds.

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting usually starts at 7 PM CT.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "at the beginning of the East Coast broadcast at approximately 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT" (8 ET = 7 CT)
verifications.reasoning: Source implies 7 PM CT via time zone conversion but does not state CT or 'usually' directly.

verifications.claim: The American Idol voting website is americanidol.com/vote.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly provide the exact website URL.

verifications.claim: American Idol voting requires creating an account on the website.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Go to AmericanIdol.com/vote and register. Then you simply sign in" (R1); "You will need an ABC account, which you can sign up for" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm registration/account creation is required for website voting.

verifications.claim: American Idol text voting uses the number 21523.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm the text number 21523.

verifications.claim: American Idol social media voting is by commenting the contestant's name on the pinned "Official Vote Post" on Instagram and Facebook.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "comment with the name of the hopeful ... official pinned social media post ... Facebook, Instagram or TikTok" (R1); "Commenting on the pinned official voting post ... Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok" (R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly describe commenting contestant name on pinned post on specified platforms (among others).

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "at least 16 years old ... to vote on ABC.com" (R1, R3); "at least 16 years old ... online" (R2); note 18+ for social

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voters must be located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "located in the U.S., Puerto Rico or the U.S. Virgin Islands to vote on ABC.com" (R1, R2, R3); "located in the U.S. to vote on social" (R1, R3)
verifications.reasoning: Supported for website voting; social limited to U.S. only (subset); claim broader but not contradicted.

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting is generally open during live episodes.

verifications.evidence: "voting number ... displayed during each night's performances" (R1); "Voting takes place during each coast-to-coast live show" (R2); live shows on Mondays (R4)
